notablePrerequisites:
Peregrine Drake in graveyard with a sticker on it.
You control lands that tap for at least {4}{B}.
description:
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Peregrine Drake triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Tap those lands to add {4}{B}.
Sacrifice Peregrine Drake to Altar of Dementia, milling target player two cards.
Repeat.
